faehigkeiten.name: mako-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Erklärt abgelehnte Anmeldungen, APERAK-Fehler und hängende Prozesse.

liest.wozu: The workflow state of the process that failed.
Whether the PID is served in the format version the counterparty used.
Whether our own message ever left, before blaming the counterparty.
Deliveries that were abandoned, for a process with no APERAK at all.
The full timeline and deadline status behind the same process.
Master data completeness for an NB rejection: Netzebene, Bilanzierungsgebiet, NB assignment.
Whether the NB contract the Anmeldung needs exists for the period.

faehigkeiten.name: deadline-alert-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Ordnet jeden Prozess nahe oder nach seiner Antwortfrist nach Dringlichkeit und nennt, wer antworten muss.

liest.wozu: The overdue set, already ordered most-urgent-first with `deadline_at` and `deadline_source` on every row.

faehigkeiten.name: desk-assistant
faehigkeiten.zweck: Beantwortet eine Frage zum Kunden, zur Marktlokation, zum Prozess oder zur Entscheidung auf dem Bildschirm, jeden Satz mit seiner Quelle.

liest.wozu: The customer on screen and every Lieferstelle with its status.
The processes under a MaLo-ID, each with its pending deadlines.
A process's messages in and out, with PID and time.
A decision held for a person: its process, its Frist, the frozen answer or none, and per action the codes its Entscheidungsbaum allows.
A disputed INVOIC receipt: its sender, PID, outcome and whether the answer went out.
The invoic-checker findings of a receipt, each with its kind and sentence — the grounds a dispute rests on.
A booking the ledger refused: its Buchungsart, amount, Beleg, the refusal and the first open date to book it on.
A customer account's ledger movements, newest first, each with its Beleg, and the balance the window opens at.
The addresses — document, edition, chapter or § — whose passage holds the given words, best first. Addresses only, never text: quote one with quote_source.
The passage at one address, verbatim, with its page and the document's SHA-256. An address the index does not hold is refused, never answered with a nearby passage.
Open processes on given MaLos, the earliest Frist first, each with the Festlegung its deadline came from.

faehigkeiten.name: billing-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Prüft eine bestrittene Rechnung gegen die Zahlungsavise und schlägt die Korrektur der Abrechnung vor.

liest.wozu: The disputed INVOIC receipt and the six check results behind the dispute.
One check's detail, once `get_receipt` says which of the six failed.
Whether the disputed invoice has been paid, partially paid or is still open.
The Rechnung behind the receipt, to compare positions against the dispute.
Why one position holds the amount it does — the arithmetic-error path.
PreisblattNetznutzung validity dates, for a check-4 tariff mismatch.
The Marktlokation the receipt names, for the Sparte and the NB assignment.
The open balance behind a Mahnung, on `de.accounting.mahnung.issued`.
Which Mahnstufe the customer is on, so an escalation is not repeated.

faehigkeiten.name: netzbilanz-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Überwacht Abrechnungsentwürfe des Netzbetreibers, überfällige Versände und Zahlungsbestätigungen.

liest.wozu: The invoice draft in full, including `check_findings` and the calculation trace.
Drafts across a portfolio, filtered by Sparte for the PID-sharing sweep.
Invoices a counterparty rejected, so one dispute can be read against the rest of the period rather than on its own.
Drafts past their dispatch window, with what is still to collect.
Activations registered but never quantified, which would go to the ÜNB as zero cost.
Storni and corrections already raised against a draft's period.
The Preisblatt a position's `tariff_source` claims to have come from.

faehigkeiten.name: invoice-reconciliation-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Ordnet eingehende Zahlungsavise offenen Rechnungen zu und nennt den nächsten Schritt bei Abweisungen.

liest.wozu: The disputed or overdue receipt in full.
What has been paid against it. Only REMADV 33001 confirms a payment — 33002, 33003 and 33004 are Abweisungen, and the process has no Teilzahlung.
Receipts whose payment window has passed, for the escalation ladder.
The outstanding balance the receipt should reconcile to.
A customer account's ledger movements, newest first, each with its Beleg, and the balance the window opens at.
The original Rechnung, to compare against the disputed amount.

faehigkeiten.name: billing-anomaly-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Sucht Rechnungen, die stark vom Verlauf der letzten Monate abweichen, und nennt die wahrscheinliche Ursache.

liest.wozu: The invoice and the deterministic risk gate's own verdict on it.
The rolling three-month baseline this specialist triages against.
Which position moved, once the total is known to have moved.
Metered consumption for the period, to tell a data error from a real change.
Whether the period was billed on substituted values (QUALITY_SUBSTITUTION).
Whether a meter exchange falls in the period (METER_EXCHANGE).

faehigkeiten.name: billing-regulatory-guard-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Prüft jede versandte Endkundenrechnung auf die gesetzlichen Pflichtangaben.

liest.wozu: The full Rechnung JSON every § 40 EnWG field check reads.
Whether the tariff the invoice was built from is itself well-formed.
The Preisgarantie window the repricing check needs — without it the check is unanswerable.
The § 42 EnWG Energiemix and CO₂ figures the invoice must carry.
The Netzbetreiber code § 40 Abs. 2 Nr. 5 EnWG requires on the invoice.

faehigkeiten.name: jahresabrechnung-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Bereitet die Prüfung einer Schlussabrechnung aus Zählerständen, Tarif und Konto vor.

liest.wozu: Twelve months of consumption for the MaLo, month by month.
Which of those months rest on substituted values.
The NB assignment for the billing year.
PreisblattNetznutzung validity across the year.
Account movements proving billed advances, payments, reversals and clearings.
The authoritative current account balance used to reconcile the ledger window.
The § 42 EnWG Energiemix the Schlussabrechnung must carry.

faehigkeiten.name: eeg-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Begleitet Förderende, Anschlussvermarktung und Abrechnungsfragen der Erzeugungsanlagen.

liest.wozu: Plant master data: Förderende, settlement model, Inbetriebnahmedatum.
Plants inside the Förderung expiry window, for the operator checklist.
Whether the plant meters in 15-minute intervals — the iMSys indicator.
Whether EPEX day-ahead prices exist for a contractually dynamic post-EEG product.

faehigkeiten.name: eeg-compliance-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Prüft die Pflichtzahlungen und Vermarktungspflichten der Anlagen auf Verstöße.

liest.wozu: Plant master data: Leistung, Veräußerungsform, Energieträger.
einsd's own § 52 EEG violation verdict for the plant.
Biogas annual-cap utilisation under § 44b EEG 2023.
Plants above the § 21 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 ceiling still on the Einspeisevergütung, which therefore carries no claim.
Lawful cuts to the anzulegender Wert, so a smaller Gutschrift is not reported as a violation.

faehigkeiten.name: payment-reconciliation-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Gleicht Bankrückläufer mit dem Kundenkonto ab und nennt die nächste Mahnstufe.

liest.wozu: The customer's current balance.
The entries behind that balance.
Collections still in flight, so a return is not double-counted.
The Mahnstufe already reached, so an escalation is a step and not a repeat.

faehigkeiten.name: compliance-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Vergleicht, wie schnell und automatisch Anmeldungen verbundener und fremder Lieferanten bearbeitet werden.

liest.wozu: STP rates by market role — the § 20 Abs. 1 EnWG parity comparison itself.
The KPI summary the Gleichbehandlungsbericht (§ 7a Abs. 5 Satz 3 EnWG) draws on.
One family's straight-through rate, to explain a deviation the parity report shows.
Decisions split by affiliated and non-affiliated counterparty — the discrimination question, per decision.
Which refusal codes drive a role's lower rate, so a deviation has a cause.

faehigkeiten.name: msb-history-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Verfolgt Wechsel des Messstellenbetreibers und hängende Ableseaufträge.

liest.wozu: The MaLo's device and MSB timeline.
Reading anomalies, to test whether they coincide with an MSB change.
INSRPT reading orders and their state.
Reading orders past their window — the stuck ones.
The MSB assignment of record, to compare against edmd's history.
The Messlokation the device sits on.

faehigkeiten.name: meter-data-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Findet Lücken in Messwerten, liest ihre Qualität und nennt, welches Ersatzwertverfahren zulässig ist.

liest.wozu: The A/B/C/F quality grades for the period.
The intervals themselves, to measure how wide an F-grade gap is.
Whether the gap falls inside a period that is about to be billed.

faehigkeiten.name: grid-anomaly-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Findet Marktlokationen, denen Netzzuordnung oder Netzvertrag fehlt, bevor eine Anmeldung daran scheitert.

liest.wozu: Netzebene, Bilanzierungsgebiet and the NB assignment are fields on the Marktlokation.
Whether a valid NB contract covers the MaLo, which is processd's check 5.
Which Marktpartner holds the NB role for the MaLo at the relevant date.

faehigkeiten.name: tariff-optimization-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Findet Kunden mit intelligentem Messsystem, für die ein dynamischer Tarif in Frage kommt.

liest.wozu: The MaLo's rolling three-month average, the baseline for a saving estimate.
What the same consumption would cost on the candidate product.
Whether 15-minute readings exist — the § 41a Abs. 2 EnWG iMSys precondition.
Whether day-ahead prices are available for the billing period.
Dynamic products the customer could move to.
The product the MaLo is on today.

faehigkeiten.name: vertragd-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Wacht über Preisgarantien, Preisänderungsmitteilungen, auslaufende Verträge und hängende Anmeldungen.

liest.wozu: Every Vertragskomponente and its state, including `preisgarantie_bis`.
Every Lieferstelle still ANGEMELDET, with its customer and makod process.
The processes under a MaLo with their pending deadlines — whether an Anmeldung is late.
Contracts and price guarantees inside the notice window.
The earliest lawful end date, with the rule it rests on named.
Whether a Tarifwechsel would cross an active price guarantee.
The customer behind the contract, for the notice obligations.
A process's state and the Antwortcode its answer carried.
Products a renewal offer could be built from.

faehigkeiten.name: productd-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Prüft den Produktkatalog auf fehlende Börsenpreise und eine veraltete Stromkennzeichnung.

liest.wozu: The product definition the event names.
Whether the definition is well-formed BO4E.
The § 42 EnWG Energiemix and CO₂ figures, and their age.
Day-ahead price coverage for a dynamic § 41a product.
The expired quotation and its customer, for the ERP follow-up.
Every published product, for the annual Energiemix sweep.

faehigkeiten.name: processd-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Erklärt, welcher Prüfschritt eine Anmeldung abgelehnt hat, und verfolgt die Freigabewarteschlange.

liest.wozu: Which of the six checks failed, and why.
Decisions across the period, to tell a one-off from a pattern.
One approval-queue item in full.
Anmeldungen waiting on a human rather than on data.
The Marktlokation behind checks 1, 2 and 5.
The NB contract behind checks 3 and 5.
The Messlokation, where the failure is on the metering side.

faehigkeiten.name: sperrd-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Verfolgt Sperr- und Entsperraufträge und meldet, was über dem gewünschten Termin liegt.

liest.wozu: The queue's own counters — `iftsta_stuck` is the finding that matters.
Orders past the date the Lieferant asked for, with `ist_fixtermin` and `soll_am`.
One order in full, once the queue says which.
Orders across the period, to tell a backlog from a single failure.
Whether a `gpke-sperrung` process reached ValidationPassed for the MaLo.

faehigkeiten.name: portald-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Stößt Benachrichtigungen im Kundenportal an, etwa zur neuen Rechnung oder zum Tarifwechsel.

liest.wozu: Whether this LF supplies the MaLo, and so whether there is a customer to notify.
The invoice list the notification would point at.
The invoice total the notification quotes.
The balance a Mahnung notification must agree with.
The Mahnstufe the reminder is about.
The Abschlag a contract-change confirmation quotes.
The customer's plants behind an EEG Förderung expiry notification.
The Förderende the EEG notification quotes.

faehigkeiten.name: regulatory-reporting-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Stellt die Kennzahlen für den jährlichen Bericht zur Gleichbehandlung zusammen.

liest.wozu: The KPI figures the report is assembled from.
Parity between market roles, per process family.
One family's straight-through rate, where the report needs the detail.
Which refusal codes account for a rate below target.
Affiliated versus non-affiliated outcomes — the reportable comparison.

faehigkeiten.name: replacement-value-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Empfiehlt für fehlende Messwerte das Ersatzwertverfahren, mit Begründung.

liest.wozu: The F-grade intervals that need a substitute value.
The intervals around the gap, which decide the method and prove the result.
Substitutions already applied to the period, so one is not proposed twice.

faehigkeiten.name: mabis-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Überwacht die Summenzeitreihen und ihre Clearingfenster und erklärt fehlgeschlagene Lieferungen.

liest.wozu: The failed run named by the event: phase, attempt count and error.
Whether a submission for the affected period is pending or already corrected.
Every open § 9.8.1 correction obligation.
Failures across the period, to tell one bad run from a systematic gap.
Which MaLos are missing data behind an aggregation error.
Quality flags on the period the Summenzeitreihe aggregates.
Whether the affected MaLo's intervals are substituted in the aggregate.

faehigkeiten.name: smgw-diagnostics-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Findet ablaufende Zertifikate, Kommunikationsfehler und stockende Rollouts der Gateways.

liest.wozu: The MaLo's gateway and MSB timeline.
Whether the gateway fault has already disrupted metering.
Reading orders left outstanding by a gateway that stopped answering.
The technical resource behind the gateway's CLS channel.
The steuerbare Ressource a § 14a control channel must reach.

faehigkeiten.name: vpp-billing-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Prüft die Abrechnung von Abrufen des virtuellen Kraftwerks auf Unstimmigkeiten.

liest.wozu: Settlements by `tx_id`, for the completeness and duplicate checks.
One settlement in full, for the arithmetic and Art. 17 attribute checks.
Whether the SR-ID the dispatch names exists as a steuerbare Ressource.

faehigkeiten.name: gabi-gas-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Legt einen Klärfall an, wenn die verbindliche Allokation für einen Gastag ausbleibt.

faehigkeiten.name: einsd-batch-agent
faehigkeiten.zweck: Startet die monatliche Abrechnung aller Anlagen und meldet, was dabei auffällt.

liest.wozu: The batch's work list: plants not yet settled for the billing month.
Violation flags, Einspeisemanagement and Förderende for a plant in NEEDS_REVIEW.
The § 21 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 claim sweep across the portfolio.
§ 44b EEG 2023 cap utilisation for every active biogas plant.
Plants reaching Förderende inside the notice window.
Whether a plant's state actually moved to SETTLED after the batch ran.
Prior-month meter data for the plant being settled.
Whether a post-EEG plant has a product configured to be paid on.
